case_name: Smt. Shobha W/O Ishwarappa Gorabal vs Smt. Kashawwa W/O Vithal Khanagavi

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Shobha W/O Ishwarappa Gorabal, household work and agriculture
parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Kashawwa W/O Vithal Khanagavi, agriculture

facts_of_case: Parties are Smt. Shobha and Smt. Kashawwa. Suit filed for partition and separate possession.

legal_principles.principle: A child of a marriage which is null and void under Section 11 is statutorily conferred with legitimacy.
legal_principles.held: In terms of sub-section (1) of Section 16, a child of a marriage which is null and void under Section 11 is statutorily conferred with legitimacy.
cited_cases: Revanasiddappa and Another Vs. Mallikarjun and Others, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: A child born from a voidable marriage which has been annulled by a decree of nullity under Section 12 is deemed to be their legitimate child.
legal_principles.held: In terms of sub-section (2) of Section 16, where a voidable marriage has been annulled by a decree of nullity under Section 12, a child 'begotten or conceived' before the decree has been made, is deemed to be their legitimate child notwithstanding the decree.
cited_cases: Revanasiddappa and Another Vs. Mallikarjun and Others, (Year) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: Suit partly decreed for partition and separate possession.

use_for_drafting: advising on Hindu undivided family property disputes
